title: nephrodium leuzeanum
intro: Nephrodium leuzeanum, commonly known as Leuze's fern or Leuze's maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Matoniaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium leuzeanum include serving as an anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
